# ANDAR external Flash programming algorithm

`ANDAR_P25Q80H_8M_FLASH.FLM` is the vendor-supplied Keil programming
algorithm for the external P25Q80H-compatible 8 Mbit SPI NOR used by ADT6101P.

Source package:
`swu_university/public/KEIL_Download/ANDAR_P25Q80H_8M_FLASH.FLM`

Install it under `Keil_v5/ARM/Flash` before configuring Keil/J-Link direct
download. Do not rename or modify the binary.
